card.name: How long treatment continues or effects last
card.fires_on: Time units or linking words (days, hours, until, a number) in statements about how long therapy should continue or how long an effect lasts after the last dose or after symptoms resolve.

modes.label: Continue after symptoms resolve
modes.description: The unit of time or 'until' in an instruction to keep treating for a set period or until symptoms have gone.

modes.label: Time after stopping or dosing
modes.description: A time word counting how long an effect or enzyme change lasts after the drug is stopped or given.
modes.example: Enzyme activities returned to baseline levels 14<< days>> after discontinuing rifapentine tablets.
